features.title: Contract: game modules as stubs, mouse input, Vec2
acceptance: GameSetup builds the modules of MODULES.md in its order (Arena, Control, Owners, Dogs, Props, Leashes, Bodies, Hits, Rules, Match; Rules holds the rule set chosen by `rules` in the arena json); each module's DependsOn equals MODULES.md; Modules/Example and its data are removed

Bodies stub already exposes the API from ARCHITECTURE.md → «Модули и порядок тика» (add circle body with mass/radius/friction, kinematic and fixed bodies, drive velocity, add rope between two bodies, positions, velocities, contacts of the tick) with plain Euler integration and no collisions, so F-003 and F-004 can go in parallel
Hits stub exposes the list of hits of the tick (attacker, victim, strength, strong flag); Match stub exposes Award(player, points, reason), scores and time left

PlayerInput carries AimX, AimY (short, centimetres), a mode bit (cursor / push) and ability buttons (LMB/Q = dog ability, RMB/E = owner ability, per design/overview.md → «Кнопки»); InputLog round-trips it; a test replays a logged session to the same StateHash
Game.Core/Math has Vec2 and a deterministic integer Sqrt on Fixed with unit tests; no float/double in state

data skeleton loads through GameData: Data/arenas/park.json and Data/arenas/sandbox.json (24 × 16 m), Data/dogs/collie.json, Data/owners/teen.json, Data/owners/jock.json, Data/hits.json, Data/control.json, with numbers from design/overview.md → «Общие числа» and the tables in design/roster.md
contract tests in Game.Core.Tests/Contract pass; an empty-input session ends no later than game.session.max_seconds

features.title: Bodies and Arena: 2D physics with rope leashes
acceptance: Bodies: circles with mass, velocity and ground friction; physics substeps per tick from data (`bodies.substeps`, start 4); kinematic and fixed (infinite mass) bodies

rope constraint: distance ≤ length with slack allowed, stiffness from data (rope ↔ rod, ARCHITECTURE.md → «Своя физика»); module test: a dog body running at 7 m/s drags an owner body that stays within leash length; after the dog stops the owner slides and stops by friction

collisions circle–circle, circle–circle obstacle, circle–rectangle obstacle and arena bounds; contacts of the tick carry both bodies and relative speed; test: a 0.4 m body at 14 m/s does not pass through a 0.4 m body
Arena loads bounds, obstacles (trees as circles, benches as rectangles), spawns and `rules` from Data/arenas/<name>.json
Bodies knows no game words (dog, owner, hit): ARCHITECTURE.md → «Модули и порядок тика», `Bodies` is dumb; same seed and inputs → same hash in module tests

features.title: Control, Dogs, Owners, Leashes: collie with teen or jock
acceptance: Control implements both modes from design/overview.md → «Управление»: «толчок (сдвиг мыши напрямую задаёт скорость собаки с потолком) и курсор (собака бежит к точке на арене)»; tests: same intent from each mode for a simple path; the mode bit switches mode mid-session

Dogs: border collie from design/roster.md → «Собаки»: speed 7 m/s, 0→max 0.2 s, mass 2, leash 3 m, passive «Мгновенный разворот без заноса»; no abilities in sprint 1 (concept → «Первый спринт»); breed is a class in Modules/Dogs/Breeds/ with its numbers in Data/dogs/

Owners: teen (mass 60, medium friction) and jock (mass 110, low friction) from design/roster.md → «Хозяева», as classes in Modules/Owners/Types/; no abilities and no behaviour passives in sprint 1, the owner moves only by the leash; owner has no health (invariant «Хозяин неуязвим»)
Leashes: one straight rope per dog body to its owner, registered in Bodies; tension 0..1 exposed for the view; no wraps or knots in sprint 1
each player picks owner (teen / jock) in the session setup; bots get a pick from Data/bots/session.json

features.title: Hits: blow, knockback, stun and the hit events
acceptance: resliced by the techlead (2026-11-10): this feature is the Hits module only; the owner speed ceiling went to F-021 and the sandbox rule set with `--arena sandbox` to F-022. Start from branch feat/F-004 (commit 5a0ebeb): keep its Hits module, the Dogs stun check and HitsTests; its owner speed rule (Owners, Data/owners/speed_rule.json), Sandbox rules, Game.Sim `--arena`, `Archetype.Opponents`, the UnityShell edit and its lines in decisions.md and discuss-later.md are not in this feature's diff

hit rule quoted from design/roster.md → «Удар»: «Удар засчитывается, когда хозяин касается чужой собаки с относительной скоростью ≥ 5 м/с. Сила = масса хозяина × скорость², отброс и оглушение растут с силой». Read literally (ARCHITECTURE.md → «Модули и порядок тика», `Hits`): a Bodies contact between an owner body and the dog body of another player with `Contact.RelSpeed` ≥ `hits.threshold_mps` is a blow by the owner's player, whichever of the two was moving (a dog that rams a standing foreign owner is hit by him; the question is logged for Nick in discuss-later.md); no extra condition on the owner's own speed. Strength = owner mass × RelSpeed²; strong hit at RelSpeed ≥ `hits.strong_threshold_mps` (9); all numbers in Data/hits.json with the «тюнить» list

knockback and stun from design/overview.md → «Общие числа»: the dog is thrown along the contact normal away from the owner with a speed that ground friction alone stops after 2–7 m; the distance grows with strength between `hits.knockback_strength_min` and `hits.knockback_strength_full`, so the jock throws farther than the teen at the same speed (sprints/S-1.md: «разница между лёгким подростком и тяжёлым качком ощущается в замахе»); stun = 0.4 + 0.05 × (v − 5) s, at most 1.2 s; a stunned or still-sliding dog (below `hits.slide_end_mps` ends the slide) is not driven by Dogs (`HitsModule.IsStunned` / `IsHelpless`, link Dogs → Hits is already in MODULES.md); test: a teen at 5.5, 7 and 10 m/s and a jock at 10 m/s throw the dog 2–7 m in growing order, a strong hit farther than 3.5 m

«Свой хозяин свою собаку не бьёт. Хозяин о хозяина — толчок без очков» (roster → «Удар»): tests that an owner touching his own dog at 8 m/s and two owners meeting at 8 m/s produce no hit, no stun and no event, and that the shoved owner really moves

events `hit`, `strong_hit`, `near_miss` with pace tags per design/overview.md → «Теги событий»: «hit → Reward нападающему по силе, Threat жертве; strong_hit → Reward 2×; near_miss → Threat»; the first strong hit of a player is also Novel; near_miss = an owner at ≥ threshold speed passed a foreign dog within `hits.near_miss_gap_m` without touching her, told once per pass; Hits writes `Hit(attacker, victim, strength, strong)` into ThisTick for Rules (no owner-type name in the record)
tests in Game.Core.Tests/Modules/HitsTests.cs with scripted velocities on the sandbox arena; same seed and inputs → same StateHash, Fork independent; no new link in MODULES.md

features.title: Owner speed ceiling: a swing needs a running dog
acceptance: rule quoted from design/roster.md → «Удар»: «Хозяин набирает скорость, только когда собака бежит поперёк поводка: потолок скорости хозяина = 1.6 × скорость собаки + бонус от натяжения. Кружение на месте даёт 3–5 м/с: толкает, но сильным ударом не становится»; lives in Owners (ARCHITECTURE.md → «Модули и порядок тика», `Owners`), numbers in Data/owners/speed_rule.json: factor 1.6, tension bonus in m/s at tension 1, hard ceiling 14 m/s (design/overview.md → «Общие числа»: «Скорость хозяина, потолок 14»), all marked «тюнить»

the ceiling brakes the excess instead of cutting it, so a shove by another owner still moves him: test: a standing owner given 10 m/s keeps most of it one tick later and is within the tension bonus of zero after 2 s

tests steering the collie in push mode on the sandbox arena: circling the teen in place gives an average owner speed of 3–5 m/s and never reaches the strong-hit threshold 9 m/s (design/overview.md → «Риск №2»: «сильный удар требует бега собаки, а не вращения на месте»); running across the taut leash reaches ≥ 9 m/s; the owner never exceeds 1.6 × 7 + bonus and never exceeds 14 m/s

the speed rule is the only change: no new link in MODULES.md (Owners already reads Bodies and Leashes), Hits and Rules untouched; the branch feat/F-004 (commit fb52d25 and 5a0ebeb, `OwnersModule.Step`, `speed_rule.json`, the three owner-speed tests in HitsTests) is a working draft to take from

features.title: Swing sandbox: mannequins and --arena sandbox
acceptance: Sandbox rule set inside Rules per design/overview.md → «Риск №1»: «песочница замаха без правил: одна собака, два хозяина, три манекена»: on arena sandbox.json player 0 plays, players 1–3 are mannequins driven by the `idle` archetype; a mannequin whose dog was hit returns, dog and owner, to its spawn `rules.sandbox.respawn_s` (2 s) after the blow through `DogsModule.ReturnToSpawn` (link Rules → Dogs is in MODULES.md; no Rules → Owners link); no zone, no points; event `arena_event` on the return
the rule set's metrics per session: `hits`, `strong_hits`, `near_misses`, `hits_per_min` for player 0 (the counter per owner type comes from running the sandbox once per owner type, below)

who drives players 1.. is named by the rule set when it needs to: `rules/sandbox.json → opponents` (`["idle"]`), otherwise `bots/session.json → opponents`; one helper `Archetype.Opponents(data)` in Game.Core/Bots is read by Game.Sim and by the Unity shell (`UnityShell/Assets/Factory/Runtime/FactoryGame.cs` and its copy in `Unity/Assets/`), so the sandbox mannequins stand in the demo build too; test: park gives smart, random, idle and sandbox gives idle

`dotnet run --project Game.Sim -- --arena sandbox` plays every tracked archetype as player 0 once per owner type in `rules/sandbox.json → owner_types` (teen, jock) and writes metrics.json keyed `archetype/owner` with the metrics above, chronicles and sessions.jsonl; the park run without `--arena` is unchanged; playtest/sim.json documents the option

tests: a mannequin returns exactly 2 s after the blow with zero velocity; a sandbox session with idle mannequins is deterministic and forks; a sandbox match ends by the Match timer; `--arena sandbox` runs green on 2 seeds (output in the review note)

features.title: King of the lawn in the park and Match
acceptance: rule quoted from design/arenas.md → «1. Парк — Царь газона»: «Светлый круг радиусом 3.5 м. В круге 1 очко/с каждой собаке внутри. Выбить соперника из круга (он был внутри, после твоего удара оказался снаружи в течение 1 с) — 5 очков, лидера — 8. Match: 120 s match (design/overview.md → «Общие числа»), scores, winner and margin into SessionResult; `final_seconds` at 10 s left

events `zone_announced` (Novel, DecisionOptions=2), `knocked_out`, `lead_change`, `final_seconds` with tags per design/overview.md → «Теги событий»; IGame.DecisionOptions offers «бежать к следующему кругу / драться» on zone_announced and «замах / отход» when a rival is within leash range
IGame.Metrics reports per player: points, points from knockouts and hits share, hits per minute, longest stretch of equal in-zone scoring (H4 in design/overview.md)

features.title: Bots: honest sensors, aimed swing, smart and camper
acceptance: IGame.Sense per design/overview.md → «Архетипы ботов»: «бот видит позиции и скорости, цель арены и её следующее место, счёт, таймер; не видит чужих намерений и будущих событий арены»

aimed swing is one shared skill in Game.Core/Bots/ (ARCHITECTURE.md → «Боты»): from seen positions and velocities it predicts the owner's arc and leads the dog so the arc passes the target, with aim_error from the archetype; strategies only pick whom and where to hit; bots play in cursor mode
archetypes.json has idle, random, smart, camper with the behaviour, reaction, hold and aim error from the table in design/overview.md → «Архетипы ботов»

swing bench: `Game.Sim --bench swing` runs each archetype in the sandbox against standing and running dummies, for teen and jock, and writes hits per minute and hit share of swings; smart/random ratio printed (H1, threshold ≥ 2.5× — reported, judged by the playtest)

features.title: Unity shell, mouse input and primitives view
acceptance: resliced three times by the techlead (2026-11-10). The work is done, committed and green on branch feat/F-007: head dfd6485 (on top of b71d9ca, the merge of the draft; d2f4ae8, the shell mirror; ab66c01, the merge of main with F-021) carries the fixes of review 1 from the worktree's .factory/review-log.md — the flash takes the speed back out of Hit.Strength, `CmPerMouseUnit` is a settable property, the InputReader branch without the legacy Input Manager throws instead of returning PlayerInput.None, the draft's preview png is dropped, the ViewMath comment is fixed; after that commit `mode=open` had no `error CS` and `mode=test` ran the 15 EditMode tests green (unity-EditMode.xml, 05:07 local), and the two shell trees differ only by .meta files. The fifth run lost its last two attempts not to the work but to the result file: the dispatcher rejected result.json because its `decisions` entries had a `title` instead of `question`, `chosen`, `why`. So this attempt is verification and a valid result: check out feat/F-007 at dfd6485 or later, run `factory tool run unity --set mode=open` once and `mode=test` once (about a minute each on the worktree's warm Library), search the logs for `error CS`, `Exception`, `Failed` and the test summary, never read a log whole (ARCHITECTURE.md → «Как Unity подключена к ядру»); if both are green, do not touch the code; if something is red, fix it and commit on feat/F-007 before writing the result. result.json must validate: `decisions` is empty or each entry is `{question, chosen, why}` — the flash formula and the sensitivity setting were decided by review 1 and are not new decisions. The demo build, the sandbox run and the screenshot are F-024 — do not run `mode=execute` here. `git status` is clean after a Unity run (Game.Core/**/*.meta are ignored since 649fcf3); nothing outside Unity/ and UnityShell/ changes

shell set up per UnityShell/README.md steps 1–4 without the build: Unity/ project, Game.Core as local package (`Unity/Packages/manifest.json` → `"com.factory.game-core": "file:../../Game.Core"`), `factory tool run unity --set mode=open` compiles without errors, `mode=test` runs the 15 EditMode tests green (InputTests, ViewTests); the shell changes the view needs (the `Stepped` event and `Alpha` for interpolation, `MenuOpen` and the cursor lock, the `-arena <name>` argument, the mouse `InputReader`) live in UnityShell/Assets/ and are mirrored into Unity/Assets/Factory/ so the two trees are identical up to .meta files (ARCHITECTURE.md → «Как Unity подключена к ядру»); UnityShell/README.md names the mouse keys instead of WASD

mouse input into PlayerInput per design/overview.md → «Управление»: «толчок (сдвиг мыши напрямую задаёт скорость собаки с потолком) и курсор (собака бежит к точке на арене)» and «Кнопки»: «ЛКМ или Q — абилка собаки, ПКМ или E — абилка хозяина»: push mode = locked hidden cursor, the mouse delta accumulated between ticks into AimX/AimY in arena centimetres with the fraction carried to the next tick, push bit set; cursor mode = visible cursor, a ray from the camera to the ground, the point in centimetres from the arena centre, push bit clear; Tab switches the mode and the mode is shown on screen; mouse sensitivity is a player setting (`InputReader.CmPerMouseUnit`), not a variant; EditMode tests drive `MouseInput` without Unity input calls (both modes, the fraction, the buttons)

view only (no game logic): sim XY on ground XZ, interpolation between ticks by `Alpha`; camera per art/style.md → «Камера»: «Сверху под наклоном около 60°, вся арена в кадре, без вращения», test: the four arena corners are inside the viewport; dog, owner, trees, benches as primitives built from code; per art/style.md → «Палитра»: «ошейник, поводок и акцент одежды хозяина в цвете игрока (красный, синий, жёлтый, фиолетовый и далее)»; the leash is a line whose thickness and colour grow with `LeashesModule.Tension`; owner shadow and cosmetic height grow with owner speed (art/style.md → «Материалы и свет»: «мягкие короткие тени под объектами, чтобы высота полёта хозяина читалась по тени»); hit flash on the victim read from `HitsModule.ThisTick` and scaled like with like: design/roster.md → «Удар»: «Сила = масса хозяина × скорость²», so the view takes the speed back out of `Hit.Strength` (square root of strength over the attacker's body mass) and compares it with `HitsModule.StrongThreshold` in m/s — a strong hit flashes fully, a weaker one dimmer (F-004 is in main; the EditMode test records hits with realistic strengths, mass × v², one between the two thresholds and one at the strong one, not by play); no file in Unity/ writes to the simulation other than `Sim.Step(inputs)`; the reviewer reads ArenaView.cs and ViewMath.cs against this criterion, the build and the screenshot are judged in F-024

features.title: Unity: demo build check and the scripted swing proven by a test
acceptance: resliced by the techlead (2026-11-10) after three attempts of two to three minutes each. They did what they could: the demo build ran green (`.factory/unity/unity-execute.log` ends in `FactoryBuild.Demo: built …Unity/Builds/demo/Unity.exe`, no `error CS`) and `mode=test` ran green (15/15), but the screenshot was never taken, and no attempt can take it: a developer-unity worker may run only `dotnet`, `git` and `factory tool run unity`, and the `unity` tool has only `create`, `open`, `execute`, `test`, all in `-batchmode -nographics`, so nobody in the pipeline starts `Unity/Builds/demo/Unity.exe` or renders a frame (ARCHITECTURE.md → «Как Unity подключена к ядру»). The screenshot art/previews/f007-sandbox-swing.png is therefore not a deliverable of this feature: a person takes it from the sprint demo build with `-arena sandbox -capture <png>` (same section) and commits it. Do not put a stand-in png or a .gitkeep into art/previews/. Start from feat/F-024 merged with main; its head be7ddf8 adds only art/previews/.gitkeep — remove it. Commits on feat/F-024 before the result is written, each commit message naming only what its diff changes; result.json validates (`decisions` empty or entries `{question, chosen, why}`)

the scripted swing of `ViewCapture` (Unity/Assets/Game/ViewCapture.cs) becomes a pure function the runtime and the tests share: `public static PlayerInput SwingInput(int tick)` returns the push-mode input of the swing per design/overview.md → «Управление»: «толчок (сдвиг мыши напрямую задаёт скорость собаки с потолком)» (push bit set, AimX/AimY the mouse shift in arena centimetres), `SwingTick` is public, `Start` only wires `SwingInput(game.Sim.Tick)` into `InputReader.Scripted`; the capture, `Application.Quit` and the `-capture` argument stay as they are, so the human run `Unity.exe -arena sandbox -capture <png>` still saves the png at `SwingTick` and exits by itself

a new EditMode test in Unity/Assets/Tests/EditMode (in ViewTests.cs or next to it, with the same `NewSim("sandbox")` helper) steps a sandbox simulation with `ViewCapture.SwingInput(sim.Tick)` for player 0 and `PlayerInput.None` for players 1–3 up to `SwingTick` and asserts what the screenshot was meant to show: the leash of player 0 is taut (`LeashesModule.Tension(sim, 0)` ≥ 0.95), the teen moves at ≥ 3 m/s (`BodiesModule.Velocity(owners.BodyOf(0)).Length`; the draft's comment claims 3.6 m/s at tick 66), so `ViewMath.OwnerHeight(ViewMath.Airborne(speed, HitsModule.StrongThreshold))` > 0 — the lift the shot shows through the owner height and shadow (art/style.md → «Материалы и свет»: «мягкие короткие тени под объектами, чтобы высота полёта хозяина читалась по тени»), and dog and owner are still inside the 24 × 16 m sandbox; if the swing does not reach these numbers, tune the amplitude, the angular step and `SwingTick` in ViewCapture.cs only, never the core or the data; no file in Unity/ writes to the simulation other than `Sim.Step(inputs)`

one `factory tool run unity --set mode=test` run after the change (16 EditMode tests green, the summary from `.factory/unity/unity-EditMode.xml`) and one `mode=execute --set method=FactoryBuild.Demo` run on the final commit, its log searched for `Build Failed` and `error CS`, not read whole; the log tails go to `notes`; `git status` is clean after the runs; nothing outside Unity/Assets/Game/ and Unity/Assets/Tests/ changes (the editor's own files, if it rewrites them, are committed as they are); the blow on a mannequin stays F-023

features.title: Unity: the collie swings the teen into a mannequin
acceptance: split from F-007 by the techlead (2026-11-10): its last criterion needed the real blow (F-004) and the mannequins (F-022), which were not in main; the build and the capture pipeline come from F-024. The demo build started with `-arena sandbox` plays design/overview.md → «Риск «скучно» №1»: «песочница замаха без правил: одна собака, два хозяина, три манекена»: the mannequins of F-022 stand idle, the pair whose dog was hit returns to its spawn after `rules.sandbox.respawn_s` (F-022's core tests prove the return; the demo shows it to Nick)

the view of F-007 shows the real hits of F-004 without changes to the core: the flash on the victim follows design/roster.md → «Удар» («Сила = масса хозяина × скорость², отброс и оглушение растут с силой»): a strong hit (RelSpeed ≥ `hits.strong_threshold_mps`) flashes fully, a weak one dimly; the thrown dog visibly slides and is not driven while stunned; nothing in Unity/ writes to the simulation

`factory tool run unity --set mode=test` and `mode=execute --set method=FactoryBuild.Demo` stay green, one run each, logs searched for `error CS`, `Build Failed` and the test summary, not read whole; no new link in MODULES.md; commits on feat/F-023 before the result is written; result.json validates (`decisions` empty or entries `{question, chosen, why}`)

features.title: Hits: the owner is the weapon, a parked owner scores nothing
acceptance: round of fixes of sprint 1 (playtest/sprint-1.md → «Странное и баги», «Предложения техлиду» 1; decisions.md 2026-11-10): a dog running at 7 m/s into a standing foreign owner is scored as a blow by that owner, so the squatter who never swings takes 71 knockout points a match and wins 88%. design/roster.md → «Удар» continues: «Хозяин набирает скорость, только когда собака бежит поперёк поводка … Кружение на месте даёт 3–5 м/с: толкает, но не бьёт», and design/overview.md → «Общие числа» says the same of the threshold; the detector now reads both sentences: a blow needs `Contact.RelSpeed` ≥ `hits.threshold_mps` AND the owner's own velocity component along the contact normal toward the dog ≥ `hits.owner_speed_min_mps` (new number in Data/hits.json, 5, in the «тюнить» list, limits 3–7; 0 restores the old literal rule).
